description: A yellow tabletop sits in front of a draped white cloth backdrop, with a light blue cleaning cloth on the surface and a white spray bottle to the right. The left hand presses the left-hand object (the blue cloth) against the tabletop and wipes back and forth—first sliding rightward, then sweeping leftward—while the right hand holds the right-hand object (the spray bottle) near the right edge and briefly shifts it slightly inward before keeping it poised as the wiping continues.
